items.name: Greater Lowell Pride
items.description: Greater Lowell is home to a diverse, resilient, and vibrant LGBTQIA+ community, and PRIDE is an opportunity for our community to come together in celebration, visibility, and solidarity.

items.name: LGBTQ2S+ Death Cafe (Online)
items.description: A Death Cafe is a group-led discussion about death. The goal of these spaces is to encourage and normalize conversations about death. Feelings about death are as diverse as people are.
items.schedule: Most Death Cafes are held from 7:00-8:30 p.m. (EST)

items.name: OUTstandingLIFE
items.description: A safe, diverse, nurturing online community of LGBTQ+ older adults. Similar to a virtual senior center, our social network is a welcoming place that fosters connectedness through free online programming.

items.name: BProud
items.description: Front-Line Services is excited to announce the BProud program to individuals in the LGBTQ+ community across Massachusetts. BProud therapists, who are members of the LGBTQ+ community, help individuals explore their gender and sexual orientation while working on all aspects of the person.

items.name: Pathway to Better Health
items.description: Offers patient-centered, compassionate care, specializing in gender-affirming hormone therapy, HIV/STI care, and addiction treatment.

items.name: Inklings Intuitive
items.description: Tarot card readings for real life. Insight and illumination you can use!
items.location: Moonlight & Mindfulness, 91 Mill Street, Unit 7 Dracut, MA 01826

items.name: Seacoast Stilettos
items.description: Seacoast Stilettos is a mission-driven, trauma-informed dance and movement studio that empowers people of all identities and experience levels through movement.

items.name: Tavern on High
items.description: Bringing a little of the City to the suburbs of the Merrimack Valley, with innovative drinks and fresh food all set in a casual atmosphere in the historic West Mill in North Andover.

items.name: Center For Hope & Healing
items.description: Offers free and confidential support to survivors of sexual violence and their loved ones, including individual counseling, medical, and legal advocacy.

items.name: LGBTQ+ Recovery Empowerment Group @ Riverbend
items.description: The goal of the LGBTQ+ Recovery Empowerment Group is to provide a confidential, supportive community to foster participants' well-being in recovery.

items.name: McVagly
items.description: McVagly is a weekly LGBTQ+ community youth group for high school and college-aged youth 14 – 23 years old.
items.location: Chapel at North Parish, 190 Academy Road North Andover, MA 01845

items.name: Nashua Outright
items.description: This monthly group is open to LGBTQ+ youth and allies in middle school and high school. There is no sign-up required.
